reason: Applying the app's global JsonSerializerOptions (custom converters, naming policy, ignore conditions) onto AspNetCore.Http.Json's default JsonOptions used by minimal APIs/MVC could change serialization behavior for existing endpoints across all modules and tenants in subtle, hard-to-predict ways.
